fusions.name: Ledge to Ledge
fusions.desc: A bounding strike at a target up to 5 tiles away that deals 8 rock damage, up to 1.5 times that at full reach. It holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Crag Drop
fusions.desc: Stamps down hard, dealing 14 rock damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stunning them for 1 second.

fusions.name: Unbudging Stance
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 20% for 10 seconds, and you move 15% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Cliff-Edge Footing
fusions.desc: When your health falls low, you gain a ward worth 20% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
